steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We're to intercept and eliminate the desert bandits en route through the target zone, then retrieve the stolen medical supplies bound for a nearby city.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: According to our intelligence, there should be about fifteen of them, half of which are former soldiers. They're well-armed and well-trained, especially their boss. He's a crafty one, having evaded local officials numerous times.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But A6 has been a team for a long time now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: An enemy of this caliber may once have been a challenge for us, but it shouldn't be too difficult for us to handle now.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Next, combat duty assignments.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Same as always for you, Spot. Your job is to draw their attention.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hm? Yeah, sure. Just let me know when we're heading off. I got comics to read.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Were you even listening?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I head in and get smacked around a bit.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Not like there's anything else I can do.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Let's just get this over with. Last month's issue should've arrived by now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Indulge me for a moment, Spot. Why exactly do you have to read so many comics?

steps.name: Spot, Lying Down
steps.text: Because that's how many comics I wanna read.

steps.name: Spot, Lying Down
steps.text: But honestly, the new stuff hasn't been very good lately. Boring topics, boring content. I'm more into retro-nostalgia stuff these days.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I know. My duty is to accompany Spot in facing the enemy, and draw out their leader. Correct?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, and here, I got the bandits' personal info. Everyone have a look-through, and it should help us come up with tactics.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Wow, 'weapon proficiencies', 'dominant hand'... This is amazing, Midnight! You're so cool!

steps.name: Spot, Squirming Over
steps.text: So this guy's showing early signs of liver failure? And this one's got bad eyes?

steps.name: Spot, Squirming Over
steps.text: How'd you get your hands on all this crap?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Even desert bandits enjoy the nightlife. If you need intel on them, what better place to check than the local pubs or other establishments?

steps.name: Spot, Squirming Over
steps.text: You sure you were just gathering intel? Why do you smell funny?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That would be the incredibly potent sunscreen I was offered by some lovely ladies.

steps.name: Spot, Squirming Over
steps.text: Well, you heard the man, Orchid. More work for you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Very well. He did inform me earlier, at least.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If that was meant to cut me, Spot, you should have chosen a sharper blade.

steps.name: Spot, Squirming Over
steps.text: You might wanna check that edge again.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight, I'll deal with you when the mission is over.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Uh-oh.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Ooh, that's me!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: As A6's assault operator, remember that your job is to take out the enemy leader.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You need to hold position until Spot and Midnight draw him out, then you act, got it?

spans.text: You need to hold position until Spot and Midnight draw him out,

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Got it, Orchid!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I promise I won't move a muscle!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Haven't I told you that you need to learn how to ask questions? You can't just nod along to everything I say. Form your own thoughts on the matter.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But everything you say is always right.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Alright then.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You three head off first. Catapult and I will support you from the sidelines.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Let's go, Spot.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Wait, there's sand in my shoes—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh* They say time will bring a team together, but all these years, and my merry band of weirdos has only become more self-centered.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I mean, I'd say we're coming together pretty well!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: As my number one problem child, you're the last person I want to hear that from.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Where even were you until just now?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Out seeing if there were any animals to hunt nearby.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You've really caught the hunting bug these past two years, haven't you?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I used to be a hunter for a while after leaving Kazimierz. Just picking up my old trade again!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So that's why you skipped the mission briefing?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You give the orders and I follow 'em. Thought you knew me by now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Look, we've been stuck together in A6 for a long time now. We've had our ups and downs, but we always made it through.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It was never realistic to get us all to sit down for a serious meeting.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't like how carefree you are about all this. My worry is that one day—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I mean, we're all good as long as that day never comes, right?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Seriously, stop worrying! It'll be fine, I guarantee it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Is this a good spot, Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes, we'll be able to observe the enemy's movements from here. Nothing beats high ground for long-ranged support.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Dang, you're right. Visibility's real good here.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Just gotta wait for the signal from Midnight's team then.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Remember, we're on observation duty. Don't you dare slack off.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yes, ma'—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Say, Orchid, got any plans for after the mission?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: None. I just want this over and done with ASAP. There are still plenty of things I need to help HR with.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well that's boring.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What about you then? What are your plans?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This is a rare trip to Sargon, so I wanna explore a little. Y'know, like an adventure!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What is there to find in the desert? It's all sand and blinding sunlight. And the sunscreen I brought has been completely useless.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You might not know this, but we're pretty close to the foehn hotlands. That's a place every explorer has on their bucket list.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I heard Columbia's actually managed to make some headway in there recently. They say that as you get closer, strange things start happening...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If you really want to go, then apply for some time off.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Aw, can't we go together?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You're the one always going on about how we gotta act like a team. It's been ages since our last team-building retreat, so why not?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...I'll consider it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Bad news.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Signs of an approaching sandstorm, and it's coming in fast!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wha? Wait, haven't the rest of the crew already engaged the target?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We need to tell them right away—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight, sandstorm approaching your position! Disengage immediately!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Crap—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Popukar...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What was that about Popukar?! Answer me!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Something's wrong, Catapult. Prepare to support!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: The sandstorm's here, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Stick close to me, and don't get lost!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Shouting) What was that?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Shouting) Bleh, my mouth's full of sand!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Shouting) The wind's too strong. I can't see anything except a ray of light—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Shouting) I think that's where Midnight's team was!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Shouting) We need to find them, quick!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Where are we?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Weren't we in a desert just now? Where'd the sandstorm go?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait, Catapult! Where's Catapult?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid! Why can't I feel the wind anymore?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: OW!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Where are we?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's what I wanted to ask you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We were in a sandstorm just now... right?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We were walking through it, and now we're here... Is... Is this... bamboo?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I scouted this place out, and I don't remember seeing a bamboo forest.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't think they even grow in Sargon.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It might be some sort of illusion...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait, what about the other three?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We need to find them ASAP!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But where do we even start? We don't know where the heck we are.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Comms terminal...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No good, I'm not getting any signal. The positioning system's out too.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whatdowedowhatdowedo—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Shut up already! You're just making me more worried. Now let me think—

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: (Higashinese?) Now withdraw!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Did you hear that?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That voice... That was Popukar!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But why is she speaking in... Higashinese?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Only one way to find out!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hey, wait for me!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: (Higashinese?) For days have I felt it in mine heart. The Gyorin spoke to me, telling me that this is where we shall find the Iju and those who hunt it. I must confirm this with mine own eyes.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: (Higashinese?) You should have left this matter to the shogun.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: (Higashinese?) Furthermore, if the Iju truly has come, there will be great danger up ahead.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: (Higashinese?) You are the lord of Houei, Your Majesty, the executor of Heaven's will. The kingdom still needs your guidance.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: (Higashinese?) Ever since Mother disappeared, the shogun hath been deluged in work both great and small. Doth this nation truly have need of me?

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: (Higashinese?) You must not belittle yourself so, Your Majesty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: (Higashinese?) Enough prattle. I fear thou hast already learnt from him his silver tongue.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: (Higashinese?) Now withdraw!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: (Higashinese?) I must find these Iju Hunters.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: (Higashinese?) I cannot allow it!

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: (Higashinese?) The shogun's orders were to stop you if you insisted on this folly, even if we must lay down our lives in the process—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, Popukar, you al... right?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err, what's with the wardrobe change? Looking good, though.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And who are these people, anyway? They don't look like the bandits we were supposed to take care of.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: (Higashinese?) Who goes there? And how dost thou know my name is Hofukaru?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You were right, Orchid, that does sound like Higashinese. Probably should've paid more attention when Midnight was teaching us useful phrases...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So you've forgotten all of it, then.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: No way! I've been prepping for a vacation in Higashi! Just listen if you don't believe me!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Higashinese) Ahem...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Where did you run off to, Popukar? We were looking everywhere for you!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I have been here from the beginning—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: See, I told you I could do it!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No, I don't think it'll be that simple.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't you recognize us, Popukar?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Why would I...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Wait, thy clothes, and thy manner of speech... Could it be...?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This is... the curse!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: 'Curse'?

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: Leave this to us, Your Majesty—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Nonsense.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What reason have I to withdraw?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What's more, the Iju Hunters I set out to find have been found.

steps.name: Lead Samurai
steps.text: Surely you don't mean these two—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Something feels kinda off. Is this really our Popukar?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: To be more precise, everything is off.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: My two good travelers... Do ye wish to aid me in hunting these cursed beasts?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar, what are you—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: If I have surmised correctly, thou art mightily perplexed.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Once this hunt is over, I shall dispel all doubt.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What do we do, Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What else can we do? Prepare to fight.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hah, that's what I'm good at!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think there's something wrong with my umbrella—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Leave it to me, then! Take this!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, something weird's going on, Orchid!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Why're these gloompincers so tough?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That black smoke...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Just what exactly that curse you were talking about earlier, Popukar?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The curse is a calamity brought by the Iju. It attaches itself to wild beasts, and provokes a great fury in them.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Your explanation's just making me even more confused!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So in simple terms, it's something that makes beasts more violent...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Any way to deal with it?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The only way to lift the curse is to bring thine all to bear in slaying the affected beast.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Should it be allowed to spread, it would give rise to all manner of bewildering phenomena!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What is even going on here?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This is bad, there's no end to them!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: We must cull the cursed beasts here. If not, the curse shall spread, and—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This isn't the time to be thrifty with ammo, Catapult!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What now?!
Ow ow ow, my rib...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot?! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Spot? Who's Spot? My name is Suponosuke!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Supo...nosuke?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I'm upgrading this kite.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Why would you need a kite this big?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: It's a transport kite. You can use it to fly, so long as there's a strong breeze.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: It makes surveying the terrain a lot easier.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And since when were you so inventive, Sp...ponosuke?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wait, now's not the time for this! We need a way to take care of all these gloompincers!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Leave it to me!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Spot, my man...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Even with all your excuses, I always knew we could count on you in a pinch!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's go, Popukar. We'll leave this place to him—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Sir Suponosuke is one of our nation's most renowned smiths, but—
The man called Suponosuke stands atop the hill, kneeling on one knee as he watches the approaching gloompincers. There is no hint of fear on his face. Instead, he wears an expression of excitement.
He puts down the bundle on his back and takes out a long-barreled launcher made of bamboo, then loads it with several brown spheres before heaving it onto his shoulder.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, that must be some kind of launcher!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Spot really knows his stuff!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Something's not right.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Time to try my new weapon! Its name is—

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: The Shoulder-Mounted Bomb Launcher!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: And it's loaded with my new-and-improved Super Bombs!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I don't care if you're an Iju or what, get off our land already!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha, the change of clothes is kinda weird, but I gotta say, looking good!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eh?
Catapult had expected him to launch giant bombs to drive away the gloompincers, but she was mistaken.
Instead, an explosion ripples out of the launcher, followed by the sound of the ammunition within exploding, then—
An incredible stench begins to flow from him, rapidly spreading across the entire area.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What is with that smell?! It's disgusting!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Crap! I used the wrong ammo! Those were dung bombs!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Gah, it stinks!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And why do you have dung bombs?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Urgh—Such tools use the most pungent of scents to drive off beasts. But I must say, this nauseating odor is especially—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Spot, you idiot, you were supposed to drive off the beasts, not us!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I can't believe I trusted you!

steps.name: Wild Beasts
steps.text: (Feeble cries)

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Even so, with this they dare not approach us. This is an opportunity to wipe them out!

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Urgh... Gah...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Our side's already getting wiped out though!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Samurai, Sir Suponosuke, retreat with our two Iju Hunters. I shall settle this!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hoo...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What do we do, Orchid? They all retreated.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Follow Popukar—no, Hofukaru!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hah, hah... Dealing with this smell while fighting is just inhumane.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'm gonna have to pull out some of Spot's fur later...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You've been frowning for a while now. What's wrong?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot says his name is Suponosuke, and Popukar is calling herself Hofukaru. Neither of them recognized us.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Their personalities seem to have changed, too. An independent Popukar, an enthusiastic Spot... Geez, don't tell me there's a responsible Midnight running around too?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: You needn't have joined me. I alone shall suffice to handle these beasts.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How could we leave you all on your own?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Never mind that, I've got a question for you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar, no, Hofukaru. I really don't want to ask, but—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you know anyone who looks handsome on the outside, but is actually a good-for-nothing, rotten womanizer on the inside?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I would describe none of mine acquaintances in such a manner.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Then do you know anyone called Midnight?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: C'mon, Orchid, nothing's that easy.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: He, I do know.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The shogun of Houei is indeed named Midnight. Verily, it is precisely for his name that our people know him as the Midnight Shogun of Houei.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Though I loathe him, I must admit he is an earnest and diligent man, one who always thinks of his nation.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's just like you said. An opinionated Popukar, an unreliable but cheery Spot...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And now a serious, responsible Midnight... I can't believe it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yeah, are we even talking about the same guy?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This is Midnight, for crying out loud! If everyone else on Terra died, things like 'seriousness' and 'responsibility' would already be extinct!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I happen to have here a portrait of him. Thou mayest look, and see if he is indeed the Midnight familiar to thee.
Hofukaru pulls out a scroll from her robes, unfurling it before Orchid and Catapult.
It depicts three people: first, a young Hofukaru standing shyly beside a woman she closely resembles, presumably her mother.
By their side stands a young man, dressed in the garb of a samurai.
As a fashion designer, Orchid knows full well that a simple change in hairstyle and outfit is enough to reshape a man's entire image.
She has even wondered if Midnight could be made into a handsome and respectable man with some tidying up.
Naturally, she had no intention of putting those idle thoughts to reality.
But now, she knows she was right.
After all, the man in the portrait is starry-eyed and sharp-browed. A beacon of righteousness, a dignified pillar of a nation.
And the spitting image of Midnight.
She cannot stop herself from slapping her forehead as she gasps.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What the heck is going on here?!
Orchid's scream echoes through the bamboo grove, startling a flock of fowlbeasts.
